17|noa is norma v0.4.0's model-driven context compression, exposed as an experimental toggle
18|in system settings. It is mutually exclusive with built-in compaction. noaadapter.Enable is
19|the sole entrypoint, installing the Compactor, Compress tool and three persistent prompts.
20|Without Enable, built-in compaction remains active. Each agent's injected noaEnabledFn is read
21|once per run, so toggling affects later runs without rebuilding the agent.
23|enableNoa wires noa into opts when enabled by the resolver. archiveRoot is the persistent base
24|directory for original compressed content (global workDir; all agents use <workDir>/noa rather than
25|separate task/intent directories). Globally unique sessionID names the archive subdirectory.
27|Experimental noa failures must not interrupt real tasks: report via onWarn and fall back to built-in compression.
